Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C154791 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154791-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, then click Save.
  • Write down the date and time on your computer clock just before step 1.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
